scope.purpose: Give one form control a visible label, an optional description, a required marker and a validation message, and link them to the control for assistive technology.
useCases: A labelled InputText or Textarea in a form, with a hint (format, constraints) and an error message after validation.
A RadioGroup with its question as the group label.
A single Checkbox that must be checked (terms acceptance) with an error message.
Required fields marked next to the label.
exclusions: Visually hidden labels: use the control alone with its label prop.
Horizontal layouts (label beside the control) and multi-control groups (FieldGroup, CheckboxGroup): later candidates.
Switch: a setting applied immediately has no validation; it carries its own label and description.
Validation logic, error summaries, focus management and live announcements after a submission: the application.
Success and warning messages: only the invalid message is in scope.
alternatives: The control alone with its own label for a self-explanatory control (search box, table row selector).
TextField (later): Field + InputText as one component.

versions.bitsUi: not used (label, texts and links around the control, which owns the native semantics)

decisionsTaken: Controls perform no validation and expose invalid/required only; the visible error message and required marker belong to Field (catalog composition rule: controls are standalone, Field wraps them).
Order: label, description, control, message. The description sits before the control so it is read before typing; the error message sits below the control, where the eye returns after typing.

Field typography is fixed (label typography.label.md, description and message typography.body.sm) whatever the control size: the label is a question in medium weight, option labels inside controls are answers in regular weight. Gaps use space.content.* and follow density.
Field passes required, invalid and disabled to its control (OR with the control props) so that one source of truth drives both the marker and the control state.

The message shows only when invalid and non-empty, with the intrinsic warning-circle glyph (Phosphor, inline SVG in the component folder) so that the error is not conveyed by color alone; color.status.danger.content is reused for the text, with a new inventory contrast pair on surface.default (4.5).
Field accepts InputText, Textarea, Checkbox and RadioGroup; Select, Combobox and later entries will be added to accepts when they exist.
Required marker A: an asterisk after the label in color.content.secondary, hidden from assistive technology; the control exposes required (user at the contract gate, 2026-10-26, "A pour 1").

Field shares its state with the control through the Svelte context key `ggb:field` (a string, so no component folder imports another); each control declares the same shape locally. Text entries register their element id (the label `for` follows it) and every control is also named through aria-labelledby, which holds before hydration and with an id of the consumer.
Description and message are div elements rather than paragraphs, so that application paragraph styles cannot move them.
Around a Checkbox, the checkbox wraps itself in role="group" named by the field label; a press on the field label does not toggle it.
